title: Hibiscus Doubles Garden
focus: Add two equal small groups to practise doubles with totals up to 20.

quiz.context: At a school garden in Melaka, Aina has 6 flower stickers and receives 6 more. How many flower stickers does Aina have altogether?
At a school garden in Melaka, Wei Jie has 7 flower stickers and receives 7 more. How many flower stickers does Wei Jie have altogether?
At a school garden in Melaka, Arun has 8 flower stickers and receives 8 more. How many flower stickers does Arun have altogether?

title: Kite Festival Near Doubles
focus: Use a known double and add one more to solve near doubles within 20.

quiz.context: At a kite craft workshop in Kelantan, Aina has 2 paper shapes and receives 3 more. How many paper shapes does Aina have altogether?
At a kite craft workshop in Kelantan, Wei Jie has 7 paper shapes and receives 8 more. How many paper shapes does Wei Jie have altogether?
At a kite craft workshop in Kelantan, Arun has 8 paper shapes and receives 9 more. How many paper shapes does Arun have altogether?

title: Pasar Pagi Tens Trail
focus: Add multiples of ten with totals no greater than 100.

quiz.context: At a morning market in Ipoh, Aina has 10 bananas and receives 30 more. How many bananas does Aina have altogether?
At a morning market in Ipoh, Wei Jie has 20 bananas and receives 60 more. How many bananas does Wei Jie have altogether?
At a morning market in Ipoh, Arun has 50 bananas and receives 50 more. How many bananas does Arun have altogether?

title: Classroom Colour Blocks
focus: Combine tens and ones in two-digit addition without regrouping.

quiz.context: At a classroom in Johor Bahru, Aina has 22 colouring pencils and receives 14 more. How many colouring pencils does Aina have altogether?
At a classroom in Johor Bahru, Wei Jie has 31 colouring pencils and receives 27 more. How many colouring pencils does Wei Jie have altogether?
At a classroom in Johor Bahru, Arun has 42 colouring pencils and receives 36 more. How many colouring pencils does Arun have altogether?

title: Taman Picnic Make Ten
focus: Make ten first, then add the remaining ones to find totals within 20.

quiz.context: At a family picnic in Putrajaya, Aina has 9 snack packets and receives 6 more. How many snack packets does Aina have altogether?
At a family picnic in Putrajaya, Wei Jie has 8 snack packets and receives 8 more. How many snack packets does Wei Jie have altogether?
At a family picnic in Putrajaya, Arun has 7 snack packets and receives 6 more. How many snack packets does Arun have altogether?

title: Sticker Box Zero Heroes
focus: Notice that subtracting zero leaves an amount unchanged and subtracting the whole amount leaves zero.

quiz.context: At a reading club in Penang, Aina has 5 stickers and gives away 0. How many stickers are left?
At a reading club in Penang, Wei Jie has 8 stickers and gives away 8. How many stickers are left?
At a reading club in Penang, Arun has 10 stickers and gives away 0. How many stickers are left?

title: Aquarium Ticket Takeaway
focus: Subtract ones from teen numbers while keeping the ten intact.

quiz.context: At a school outing in Kuala Lumpur, Aina has 16 entry tickets and gives away 3. How many entry tickets are left?
At a school outing in Kuala Lumpur, Wei Jie has 18 entry tickets and gives away 6. How many entry tickets are left?
At a school outing in Kuala Lumpur, Arun has 15 entry tickets and gives away 1. How many entry tickets are left?

title: Twenty Treasure Tokens
focus: Take away different amounts from twenty and check by adding back.

quiz.context: At a school fun day in Seremban, Aina has 20 game tokens and gives away 3. How many game tokens are left?
At a school fun day in Seremban, Wei Jie has 20 game tokens and gives away 6. How many game tokens are left?
At a school fun day in Seremban, Arun has 20 game tokens and gives away 10. How many game tokens are left?

title: Playground Count Back
focus: Count back a few ones from a two-digit number without crossing a ten.

quiz.context: At a sports club in Shah Alam, Aina has 58 score counters and gives away 3. How many score counters are left?
At a sports club in Shah Alam, Wei Jie has 74 score counters and gives away 2. How many score counters are left?
At a sports club in Shah Alam, Arun has 97 score counters and gives away 5. How many score counters are left?

title: Fruit Basket Ten Exchange
focus: Exchange one ten for ten ones when subtracting a one-digit number.

quiz.context: At a fruit stall in Kuantan, Aina has 31 oranges and gives away 4. How many oranges are left?
At a fruit stall in Kuantan, Wei Jie has 42 oranges and gives away 5. How many oranges are left?
At a fruit stall in Kuantan, Arun has 63 oranges and gives away 7. How many oranges are left?

title: School Canteen Equal Groups
focus: Explore multiplication as equal groups of two or three objects.

quiz.context: At a school canteen in Alor Setar, Aina prepares 2 bags with 2 rice crackers in each bag. How many rice crackers are there altogether?
At a school canteen in Alor Setar, Wei Jie prepares 3 bags with 2 rice crackers in each bag. How many rice crackers are there altogether?
At a school canteen in Alor Setar, Arun prepares 4 bags with 2 rice crackers in each bag. How many rice crackers are there altogether?

title: Two Friends Sharing Trail
focus: Divide small even amounts into two equal groups with nothing left over.

quiz.context: At a craft club in Kuching, Aina shares 4 wooden beads equally among 2 bags. How many wooden beads go in each bag?
At a craft club in Kuching, Wei Jie shares 14 wooden beads equally among 2 bags. How many wooden beads go in each bag?
At a craft club in Kuching, Arun shares 16 wooden beads equally among 2 bags. How many wooden beads go in each bag?
